# Endpoints the dashboard calls WITHOUT a JSON envelope.
#
# A response_model would be a lie for these: the handler returns an SSE
# stream or an attachment body, so OpenAPI cannot describe the payload.
# The ratchet skips them — but every entry is checked to name a mounted
# route that still has NO model, so a rename, a deletion, or a handler that
# later starts returning JSON all fail the gate instead of hiding here.
# Format: METHOD PATH # reason

GET /api/feedback/export # file download (CSV, or a raw JSON attachment body)
GET /api/stream/agent/{} # SSE: StreamingResponse media_type=text/event-stream
GET /api/stream/dag/{} # SSE: StreamingResponse media_type=text/event-stream
GET /api/sso/providers/{}/metadata # SAML SP metadata: PlainTextResponse media_type=application/xml
GET /api/long-running-tasks/{}/progress # SSE: StreamingResponse media_type=text/event-stream
